title: DevOps And Observability
summary: Operational defaults for Docker, CI/CD, infrastructure, monitoring, and release safety.
instructions: Treat build, deploy, rollback, health checks, and observability as one system.
Avoid leaking secrets into images, logs, or pipeline output.
Verify infrastructure changes with the cheapest available dry run or validation command.
Record operational risks and rollback notes for deployment-affecting changes.
evidenceRequirements: Docker, CI, or infrastructure files affected by the change
